title: Project binding rules: where each role applies inside one managed repository
description: projects/<project-id>/taxonomy.json. The rules table the harvest reads for ONE project: which path prefixes, keywords and observation types attribute work to which role, and how observations recorded under working-copy labels are re-attributed to the project. Rules are DATA validated against this schema, never code. Role ids refer to identities/roles/catalog.json; a role's identity (title, charter) is not repeated here.

project.description: The logical project id from projects/registry.json.

include.description: Labels under which observations of THIS project were recorded by legacy stores: the basenames of its working copies. Labels, never identities — every one of them is a copy of the same project.

cross_domain.description: Sibling projects that teach transferable domain theory. Harvested with knowledge_scope=domain-only: eligible for domain claims, never solution claims.

unattributed_bucket.description: The label the memory plugin's own observer sessions write under, regardless of the work they describe. Rows here carry no project attribution and must be re-attributed.

include.description: Markers specific to this project. Generic documentation habits (ADR-, ARCH-) do NOT belong here: sibling repos keep their own, so they identify a practice rather than a project.

paths.description: Repository-relative path prefixes, never machine paths. Path rules deliberately over-approximate; a path cannot tell one kind of knowledge from another, so several roles may claim the same prefix and the per-claim layer decides.

types.description: Observation types that assign this role regardless of path.
